name: EducationUSA Advising Center - Kigali
coverage: U.S. university, scholarship, fee, testing, and visa guidance; test-preparation materials and computer/internet access.
feePosition: Advising is free; a cash grant for testing or applications is not guaranteed.
action: Book an advising appointment before building a U.S. application list.

name: Duolingo English Test Access Program
coverage: Formal test-fee waivers and preparation support for students facing financial barriers through institutions or approved organisations.
feePosition: Not a universal individual coupon; a university, adviser, or recognised organisation must request or distribute access.
action: Ask each target university whether it accepts DET and can sponsor an Access request.

name: edX Financial Assistance
coverage: Current help guidance confirms an 80% reduction on eligible verified-track certificate fees for learners experiencing economic hardship.
feePosition: Not available for Professional Education courses and selected MicroMasters.
action: Open the target course and check whether the financial-assistance option is shown.

name: Linux Foundation LiFT Scholarship
coverage: Selected recipients can receive training courses and certification exams at no cost.
feePosition: 2027 applications open in April according to the current official page.
action: Prepare a short impact statement and apply when the next window opens.

name: AWS re/Start
coverage: Free learner training, hands-on labs, professional skills, interview coaching, and complimentary certification preparation/exams for selected cohorts.
feePosition: Availability and benefits depend on the local collaborating organisation.
action: Check the country directory for a current Rwanda or regional partner.

name: AWS Skill Builder
coverage: 900+ free self-paced digital courses and free digital badges across AWS cloud, AI, and data topics.
feePosition: Certification exams and advanced subscription content are separate; no universal exam waiver.
action: Create a personal AWS Builder ID and follow the Data Analytics or Machine Learning pathway.

name: Google Cloud Career Launchpad voucher route
coverage: An Associate Cloud Engineer voucher may be available after completing an eligible cohort certificate and required skill badges.
feePosition: Not an open general voucher; cohort participation is required.
action: Look for a current Rwanda or Sub-Saharan Africa cohort before planning around the voucher.

name: Microsoft Learn
coverage: Free role-based training, documentation, hands-on modules, and learning paths for Azure, data, AI, and systems.
feePosition: Certification exams are separate unless a specific event or partner provides a voucher.
action: Build a personal learning collection around Azure data, AI, and DevOps.

name: IBM SkillsBuild
type: Free AI, data and cloud preparation
coverage: More than 1,000 free courses and shareable digital credentials in AI, data analytics, cloud, cybersecurity, and technical support.
feePosition: The source confirms free learning and credentials, not payment of external professional exams.
action: Start with Data Fundamentals, Machine Learning for Data Science Projects, or AI Fundamentals.

name: Kaggle Learn
coverage: Free short courses in Python, SQL, pandas, machine learning, and computer vision with completion certificates.
feePosition: No separate paid certification exam is required for the course certificates.
action: Complete a course and publish a small personal notebook or project.

name: British Council Rwanda IELTS preparation
coverage: Free official preparation resources; IELTS Ready Premium is included when an IELTS test is booked.
feePosition: The Rwanda page lists IELTS Academic/General at RWF 364,000 and UKVI at RWF 400,000; no general hardship waiver is shown.
action: Confirm each university's accepted test and waiver rules before booking.

name: Databricks Free Edition
coverage: No-cost personal platform for learning and experimenting with data and AI.
feePosition: Certification exams are paid; official vouchers are tied to events, partners, or pre-purchased credits.
action: Use only personal or public data and build a small documented data pipeline.
